entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2164125035679377664: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.9585 +/- 0.0236 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 143.71 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 29.930, -28.850 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.497 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-7265 B b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract). Mass 0.521 +/- 0.023 solar masses from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-7265 B b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract). Temperature 3503 +/- 59 K from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-7265 B b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,503 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc78b. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,503 K and log g 4.76 (u1 0.404, u2 0.370): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
